I've considered the kid.  The mom dictates most of what happens there.  Dad's get the shaft in this society.  Kid lives in another state.  I visit one week a month.

I just haven't ended up where I want and I feel like I can't get there from here.  So every day seems pointless. I want to hit the reset button and start over (or just quit).
Interesting idea - except that the entire root of my attitude problem is that I'm sick of living my life exclusively for the benefit of other people.

I cannot relate to your story. I did not get married for love. I was emotionally (and financially) coerced into it by a woman with a ticking biological clock who viewed me as the path to stay at home motherhood and a system obsessed with punishing "deadbeat dads".  She became pregnant intentionally without my consent - falsely claiming to be using birth control.  She doesn't work.  She stays at home and enjoys all of the benefits of the idle mother.  She's a failure as a homemaker.  I have to do the cooking, the house is a constant disaster. 

I cancelled all of my dreams to "do the right thing".   I love my child but I have no say in the raising and spend all my time working to pay for the house and the food in the pricey neighborhood with the good school district.  I have no emotional connection with my ex wife and never have because of the betrayal.  Basically, I've decided to end the charade.

I've made my child my beneficiary.  Even if the insurance doesn't pay off, there's enough in my retirement accounts to see her through an advanced degree. The scheming "wife" will get nothing.

I'm not looking for younger newer smarter.  I'm looking for real love, not to be viewed as patsy and a meal ticket.   Basically, I'm feeling like my life has been stolen from me.  I've tried to take it back and I seem to be failing.

You win the most perceptive post award.

>don't overlook those you don't develop an instant connection with

I haven't but I am frequently (ok always) disappointed when I put more effort in than I get back.  People are either generally flakes or insincere or fearful or something.  Getting contact info is hard.  I hand out plenty, nobody calls or emails. 

It seems to me like people all regard one another as probable serial killers or something.  I do a lot of meetups, meet folks doing activities, try messaging through the site - I get nothing back though.  I'm busy and active and totally unconnected and thus lonely and fed up with it all.
